name: Diary of O'Dynn
description: Crop growth time reduced by 10% of base time. Only effective if the perk is active when you plant the crop — harvesting state doesn't matter.
notes: If you have all other crop speed-up perks (which add up to 80% reduction), this perk cuts the remaining time in half. Results in 48-minute cabbage with all perks active.

name: Bahltruvian Scales
description: Silver from sales increased by 10%.

name: Odthorin's Charm
description: Crafting costs 10% less silver.

name: Stones of Gallodor
description: Pets such as Chickens, Cows, Pigs, and Raptors level up faster. +500 XP per pet feed or incubate.

name: Runecube
description: Rare items drop slightly more frequently and common items drop slightly less frequently when farming, exploring, or fishing.
notes: Reduces effective rarity by 20% on dice rolls during exploring and fishing. You may not see an exact 20% increase due to RNG, but you should see a noticeable increase in rare drops overall.

name: Growth Medallion I
description: Allows you to buy 400 more trees in the orchard.

name: Trigon Knot
description: +100 fish from Large Nets. 500 total if you also have the Reinforced Netting perk.

name: Friendship Bracelet
description: Townsfolk give you 5–15 of a random item each hour. Possible items: Orange Juice, Lemonade, Grapes, Orange, Lemon, Apple, Apple Cider, Fishing Net.
notes: Items can exceed your mailbox cap, but stop once your mailbox reaches 2,000.

name: Headdress of Luna
description: +20% chance items are duplicated when crafting.

name: Strange Gem
description: Inventory boost — gives +2,500 inventory space.

name: Growth Medallion II
description: Allows you to buy 1,500 more trees in the orchard.

name: Ashes of Pentagorn
description: Reduces resources used when you cook a meal.

name: Dragon Heart
description: Doubles rewards from Personal Help Requests.

name: Magic Mirror
description: Doubles rewards from the Wishing Well.

name: Maduin's Cup
description: Doubles the daily Grape Juice use allowance.

name: Serpent of Trym
description: 10% of Antler production generates at Noon daily, in addition to the normal daily reset amount.

name: Spring Bangle
description: 10% of orchard production generates at Noon daily, in addition to the normal daily reset amount.

name: Inferno Ring
description: 10% more output when crafting Inferno Sphere.

name: Lava Ring
description: 10% more output when crafting Lava Sphere.

name: Unusual Gem
description: Inventory boost — gives +2,500 inventory space.

name: Scythe of Dewstar
description: Gives you bonus crops on harvest.

name: Mechanical Heart
description: Adds extra items to the monthly chore reward.
notes: Adds 3,000 Apple Cider to the first reward, 2,000 Arnold Palmer to the second, and doubles the starter pack box from the third. Must be active at time of collection — not retroactive.
